notes: World Bank WDI is a secondary harmonising compiler. Never emit badge A; B maps to aggregated/official-derived and D maps to modelled. Remittances remain sourced-only pending primary-source CBK treatment.

indicators.name: Statistical Performance Indicators — Overall score
indicators.description: World Bank Statistical Performance Indicators overall score for Kenya's statistical system.

indicators.name: Access to electricity (% of population)
indicators.description: Share of Kenya's population with access to electricity, harmonised by the World Bank for international comparability.

indicators.name: GDP (current US$)
indicators.description: Kenya gross domestic product in current US dollars, harmonised by the World Bank.

indicators.name: GDP per capita (current US$)
indicators.description: Kenya GDP per person in current US dollars, harmonised by the World Bank.

indicators.name: GDP growth (annual %)
indicators.description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.

indicators.name: Life expectancy at birth
indicators.description: Life expectancy at birth in years, harmonised by the World Bank.

indicators.name: Population, total — UN projection via World Bank
indicators.description: National population estimate/projection published by the World Bank using UN Population Division data; not a census enumeration.

indicators.name: Population growth (annual %)
indicators.description: Annual population growth rate based on the World Bank/UN harmonised population series.

indicators.name: Net migration
indicators.description: Net number of migrants over the reference period from the harmonised World Bank series.

indicators.name: Human Capital Index (overall)
indicators.description: World Bank composite Human Capital Index. This is a compiled index, not a raw statistic.
indicators.disclosure: Compiled/modelled index; not a raw statistic.

indicators.name: Poverty headcount ratio at $3.00/day (2021 PPP)
indicators.description: Share of the population below the World Bank $3.00/day international poverty line in 2021 PPP terms. Not interchangeable with Kenya's domestic poverty line.

indicators.name: Unemployment, total (modeled ILO estimate)
indicators.description: Modeled ILO estimate of unemployment as a share of the total labour force, published through World Bank WDI.

indicators.name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
indicators.description: Annual World Bank harmonised consumer price inflation. The Atlas's monthly KNBS series remains the headline inflation series.

indicators.name: Personal remittances received (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Personal remittances received as a share of GDP. Kept sourced-only while a CBK-primary-source treatment is designed.
indicators.hold_reason: CBK publishes the underlying monthly remittance inflows directly; do not finalize a secondary-source headline before primary-source derivation is designed.

indicators.name: Forest area (% of land area)
indicators.description: Forest area as a percentage of land area, harmonised by the World Bank.

indicators.name: CO2 emissions per capita (excl. LULUCF)
indicators.description: Carbon dioxide emissions per person excluding land-use, land-use change and forestry, harmonised by the World Bank.

indicators.name: Freshwater withdrawals (% of internal resources)
indicators.description: Annual freshwater withdrawals as a share of total internal renewable water resources; distinct from household water access.

indicators.name: Renewable electricity share, excluding hydro
indicators.description: Share of electricity output from renewable sources excluding hydroelectric power.

indicators.name: Safely managed sanitation services (% of population)
indicators.description: Share of the population using safely managed sanitation services.

indicators.name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
indicators.description: Share of individuals using the Internet, published through World Bank WDI. Link to a Communications Authority series only after a CA series is actually ingested.

indicators.name: Intentional homicides (per 100,000 people)
indicators.description: Intentional homicides per 100,000 people, harmonised for international comparability.

indicators.name: Seats held by women in national parliament (%)
indicators.description: Share of seats in the national parliament held by women.

indicators.name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Foreign direct investment net inflows as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: GINI index
indicators.description: GINI index from the World Bank WDI series; reference year is always displayed because the series can be stale or irregular.

excluded.reason: No Kenya data available at source; record as a known limitation, do not fabricate an indicator observation.
